from client import save

class RecordingTransport:
    def __init__(self):
        self.request = None
        self.response = object()

    def put(self, path, body):
        self.request = (path, body)
        return self.response

cases = [
    ('  Ada  ', 'Ada'),
    ('Ada Lovelace', 'Ada Lovelace'),
    ('', ''),
    (' \\t\\n ', ''),
    ('\\tAda\\n', 'Ada'),
    ('\\u00a0Ada\\u00a0', 'Ada'),
]
for input_name, expected_name in cases:
    transport = RecordingTransport()
    response = save(transport, input_name)
    assert transport.request == ('/settings', {'display_name': expected_name})
    assert response is transport.response
print(f'{len(cases)} client-to-payload checks passed; inputs covered padded names, internal spaces, empty/whitespace-only names, tabs/newlines, and Unicode whitespace.')
